## v0.8.8 — Worktrees management page + orphan-worktree lifecycle fixes

### New: Worktrees management page
A new **Worktrees** screen (under *Open folder…* in the Code and Create sidebars) gives you a GitHub-branches-style view of every live worktree across your projects. See each branch's worktree folder, its state (uncommitted changes / commits ahead / behind / current), the chat using it (or "no active chat"), and act on it: **Merge** (commit → merge into main → remove), **Delete** (folder + branch), **Open in Finder**, or start a **+ New worktree conversation**.

### Fixed: worktrees no longer accumulate
- Deleting a chat (or a project) now tears down its worktree folder **and** git branch — no more orphaned worktrees on disk.
- Abandoning an empty chat that has a worktree, then opening another project, no longer leaves a dead worktree behind or creates one in the wrong project.
- A startup + per-project reconciliation now prunes stale `chatoss/` branches that have no worktree folder and no conversation.

### Includes all merged agent work from v0.8.7/v0.8.8
Create agent search-docs-first fix, agents_index tool-loop circuit breakers, reload-installed-app-on-Publish, document generation API, and more.
